topic: Shopify Next Gen Events are now generally available
caption:
Shopify just made a meaningful change to how apps can react to commerce data.

With the 2026-10 API version, Next Gen Events are now generally available across 18 topics as a declarative successor to classic webhooks.

The practical improvement is important for app developers: instead of receiving a broad webhook and then making follow-up API calls to discover what actually changed, apps can define the changes they care about and request richer data directly in the event payload.

That can mean fewer deliveries, fewer follow-up queries, and cleaner event-driven architecture.

For Shopify app teams, I’d start evaluating existing webhook-heavy flows now — especially product, collection, order, and inventory automations — and identify where richer event payloads can remove unnecessary API work.

This isn’t just a webhook upgrade. It’s a better foundation for real-time Shopify automation.

Source: Shopify Developer Changelog
